mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (user_id, category_id, title, content, like_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at, address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{viewCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{address})

INSERT INTO board_img (board_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether) VALUES
(#{boardImg.boardId}, #{boardImg.path}, #{boardImg.systemName}, #{boardImg.originName}, #{boardImg.mainWhether})
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, content, like_count, view_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address, board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether FROM board b JOIN board_img bi ON b.board_id = bi.board_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id JOIN board_category c ON c.board_category_id = b.category_id WHERE b.delete_whether LIKE 'N' AND bi.main_whether LIKE 'M' LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0
SELECT board_id, user_id, category_id, title, content, like_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at, address FROM board WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND delete_whether LIKE 'N'
